title: From the Vault: Twenty: card flavor text

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who addresses Leshrac as his liege and asks for power.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Lim-Dûl's liege, whom he petitions for power.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Creator of the metathran, whose children were made by an integrated system of machines.

entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: Urza's children, conceived, birthed and nurtured by machines.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A group of mages who often acquire magic reagents from dubious sources, making their spells unpredictable.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An artificer whose mind is said to surpass his marvels of artifice.

entities.name: Tree of Tales
entities.description: A tree on which Phyrexian prophecies glowed as the green sun crowned.

entities.name: Phyrexian prophecies
entities.description: Prophecies that glowed on the Tree of Tales.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: Wilds where a werewolf's first howl is said to echo till moonset.

events.summary: Lim-Dûl the Necromancer petitions his liege Leshrac for power.
events.quote: "Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."

events.summary: Phyrexian prophecies glow on the Tree of Tales as the green sun crowns.
events.quote: As the green sun crowned, Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.

relations.quote: "Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."

relations.note: The metathran are Urza's children, made by machines.
relations.quote: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

relations.note: The prophecies glowed on the tree.
relations.quote: Phyrexian prophecies glowed on the Tree of Tales.
